text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер looks like she's on the
brink of a
burnout, so I bring her to the
infirmary to rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry you had to go so far out of your
way for
me, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
You should take some time off to rest as
well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh? Goodness me. Where am I?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Trainer doesn't seem to be here. I
wonder what's
around.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is that a full tea set? It even
includes
top-grade gyokuro tea leaves...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
This place is so tranquil, I should take a
moment
to relax.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The caress of the breeze... The freshness
of the
air... The beautiful sky stretching
endlessly
above...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now that I've calmed down, I
realize how
surprisingly pleasant this
place is. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It was an incredible dream. I was
in this
lovely place drinking tea.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That must be why I feel so rejuvenated.
If only I
could take you there, Trainer. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Oh, dear. What happened to the
tea?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I was certain I was drinking a fresh brew
just a
moment ago... But this is the
infirmary...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So it must have all been a strange
dream, then.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Judging by her face, I'd say Grass
Wonder is back
to her usual self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems that Грасс Вандер's nap was
less than
restful.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
